name: Autism-Prediction
description: ML web app predicting Autism Spectrum Disorder traits from AQ-10 screening responses. Built with XGBoost (93% accuracy), Streamlit, and scikit-learn. Supports single and batch predictions.

name: Book-Recommendation-System
description: Book recommendation web app using item-based collaborative filtering (K-Nearest Neighbors, cosine similarity) on 1.1M+ user ratings. Built with scikit-learn and Streamlit.

name: Calorie-Burn-Prediction
description: Calorie burn prediction using XGBoost Regressor (R² 0.999, MAE 1.5 calories) trained on 15,000 exercise sessions. Built with scikit-learn and XGBoost, using physiological features like heart rate, duration, and body temperature.

name: Car-Price-Predictor
description: Car price prediction web app using Linear Regression (0.74 CV R²), selected via fair cross-validation over Random Forest and Gradient Boosting. Built with scikit-learn and Flask, with dynamic company-to-model dropdowns.

name: Credit-Card-Fraud-System
description: ML web app detecting fraudulent credit card transactions using Logistic Regression (93% accuracy) on a highly imbalanced real-world dataset. Built with scikit-learn and Streamlit, using undersampling to handle class imbalance.

name: Customer-Churn-Prediction
description: Customer churn prediction using Random Forest (84% CV accuracy) with SMOTE class balancing. Built with scikit-learn, XGBoost, and imbalanced-learn, trained on real telecom customer data with a working single-customer prediction function.

name: Diabetes-Prediction-System
description: An end-to-end machine learning project predicting diabetes risk. Compares SVC, Random Forest, and Logistic Regression on the Pima Indians dataset, selecting the top-performing SVC model (73.4% test accuracy). Deployed via an interactive Streamlit dashboard featuring robust input scaling and real-time classification results.

name: Gold-Price-Predictor
description: Gold price prediction web app using a Decision Tree Regressor (max depth 100), trained on historical multi-indicator matrices. Built with scikit-learn and Streamlit, featuring optimized memory caching and dynamically bounded slider controls synced to asset parameters.

name: Heart-Disease-Prediction
description: Heart disease prediction using Logistic Regression (80.3% test accuracy) on real clinical data — 13 patient features including age, cholesterol, chest pain type, and ECG results. Built with scikit-learn.

name: laptop-Price-Prediction
description: Laptop price prediction web app using a Random Forest Regressor (0.88 R²), selected after performance evaluation against Linear Regression and XGBoost. Built with scikit-learn and Streamlit, featuring an end-to-end serialized engineering pipeline.

name: Loan-status-prediction
description: Loan eligibility prediction using tuned XGBoost (83.3% test accuracy) on real applicant data — income, credit history, employment, and property area. Built with scikit-learn and XGBoost, includes a working single-applicant prediction function.

name: Movie-Recommendation-System
description: Content-based movie recommendation system using TF-IDF-style tag vectorization (genres, cast, crew, keywords) and cosine similarity. Built with scikit-learn, NLTK, and Streamlit, using the TMDB 5000 dataset with live poster fetching via TMDB API.

name: Olymics-Data-Analyzer
description: Interactive Olympics data analytics dashboard covering 271,000+ athlete records (1896-2016). Built with Streamlit, Pandas, and Plotly, featuring medal tallies, country comparisons, and athlete-level trend analysis.

name: Rag-Ai-Assitant-NN
description: Local RAG-based AI course assistant — transcribes course videos with Whisper, embeds transcripts using Ollama (bge-m3), and answers student questions with relevant video/timestamp references via cosine similarity search and a local LLM (Llama 3.2).

name: Rainfall-Prediction
description: Rainfall prediction using a tuned Random Forest (GridSearchCV) on weather station data — pressure, humidity, cloud cover, and wind. Built with scikit-learn; includes an honest evaluation of overfitting risk on a small dataset (234 samples).

name: Sms-Spam-identifier
description: SMS spam classifier using TF-IDF vectorization and Random Forest (96.8% accuracy, 99.1% precision). Built with scikit-learn, NLTK (tokenization, stopword removal, stemming), and deployed as a Streamlit app.

name: Submarine-Mine-Vs-Rock
description: Sonar signal classifier distinguishing rocks from naval mines using SVM (90.5% test accuracy) with PCA dimensionality reduction and SMOTE class balancing. Built with scikit-learn, tuned via GridSearchCV.

name: Titanic-Survival-Prediction
description: Titanic survival prediction using Logistic Regression (78.8% test accuracy) on passenger class, age, fare, and family data. Built with scikit-learn, includes a working single-passenger prediction example.

name: Whatsapp-Chat-Analyzer
description: WhatsApp chat analyzer web app — upload any exported chat and get message statistics, activity timelines, word clouds, emoji analysis, and most-active-user breakdowns. Built with Streamlit, Pandas, and regex-based chat parsing.
